data.one_liner: Pure Dart Firebase admin SDK for authentication and Realtime Database.
data.what_it_does: Provides server‑side access to Firebase Auth and Realtime Database using service‑account or default credentials. It supports generating sign‑in links, managing users, and performing database operations without native code.
use_when: Building a Dart backend that needs Firebase admin features
Running server‑side scripts that manage users or data
Deploying to platforms without native Firebase SDKs
avoid_when: Projects that require Cloud Storage or Firestore admin APIs
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies
Handles auth and Realtime Database admin tasks
weaknesses: Limited to Auth and Realtime Database only
No support for Cloud Storage, Firestore, or other Firebase services
data.setup_notes: Place service‑account JSON in project or set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS env variable. No build_runner needed.
